description: Fetch one app's full price book and how to call it, by the slug returned from search_apps. Call this before using an app: it lists which routes are billable, the per-call maximum, when the call settles, and the error codes the caller may see. If the request carries the user's Qumge key, it also reports that user's monthly cap for this app.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

slug.description: The app's slug, e.g. 'autowhisper'. Comes from search_apps.

name: get_app
